title: Rest in the Luminaries; the Paths Up and Down; the Cross of Light
description: Where the soul finds rest, the structural map of her options, and what is bound to the cross. T82 — the soul in trial, having stood through her appointed days, finds no resting-gate among the powers of heaven and earth (her defilers); only the Lord, as illumining wisdom and that wisdom received in her natural mind, opens for her — and at the end the Land of Light itself becomes the final receiver of those luminaries. T83 — the four ways that rise (chosen, reckoned to the light, ascending to life) and the eight ways that descend into corruption (lawlessness, killing, wounding word, blasphemy and their kindred); the structural map of the soul's options. T84 — why the natural's elements, taken into the body and bound to the Cross of Light, are stripped of their defiled garments in graded cascade until they stand fast in the New Man — or, in a soul still claiming, fall to transmigration with sentencing.
